items.title: Anatomy of a (Postgres) search engine — PlanetScale
items.summary: PlanetScale's TIN (Term-Inverted-Normalization) is a full-text search index for Postgres, supporting features like sorting and matching by exact value, range, or prefix. An inverted index is used to locate documents quickly by words, and a term dictionary maps terms to postings lists.

items.title: How do you respond when your AI tooling and models fail? | incident.io
items.summary: When AI tooling and models fail, it's not just a technical issue, but a business one. The incident highlights the importance of having a clear understanding of AI dependencies and a well-defined approach to resiliency. The team at incident.io is working on building a runbook for AI tooling and models, and is exploring practical patterns such as fallbacks, degradation, detection, ownership, and runbooks to improve their resilience. The incident also emphasizes the need for a culture shift in the industry to prioritize AI dependencies and build more resilient systems.
